title: Póster Gráfico Deportivo de Shohei Ohtani con Retrato Compuesto Dinámico
prompt: A dynamic composite portrait of Japanese baseball player Shohei Ohtani in his Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters jersey, set against a bold blue background with a stylized silver fox emblem. The composition features a large close-up portrait of Ohtani in the foreground, looking directly at viewer with serious expression, short dark hair and clean-shaven face. Behind him, a smaller action-oriented image shows him mid-celebration with mouth open in triumph, wearing the same blue jersey with team logos. A third smaller inset depicts him batting in full gear mid-swing. He wears a blue long-sleeved jersey with silver accents, white pants, and batting gear. Dramatic studio-like lighting highlighting his features and vibrant blue uniform. Background is deep blue with glowing silver fox logo evoking team identity. Text elements on left display his NPB 2025 stats: 15 innings, 687 runs, 52.85 average, 182.45 strike rate, and 8 fifties. High-impact sports graphic style combining realistic photography with bold typography and graphic design elements.
